summary.name: ProcessOn
summary.one_liner: ProcessOn is an online diagramming tool and knowledge-sharing community for building mind maps, flowcharts, Gantt charts, UML and other diagrams with real-time team collaboration.
use_cases: creating mind maps and meeting outlines
designing UML, ER or network topology diagrams
collaborating with a team on shared diagrams
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an online diagramming tool with AI generation of mind maps (standard mind map, meeting outline, to-do list, pros and cons list, SWOT analysis). It supports drawing Gantt, ER, UML, BPMN, network topology, floor plan, fishbone, org chart and swimlane diagrams. Multiple people can edit in real time, with cloud storage, version history and permission controls. Export is listed as VISIO, PDF, PNG and SVG, with import of VISIO and Mermaid formats.
notable: AI generation of mind maps and outlines from prompts
Supports Mermaid and VISIO import and export of PDF, PNG, SVG
Real-time multi-user collaboration with version history
Template library and team component library
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; the listing tag says free but the page does not confirm it
Team edition and personal edition are referenced separately, with details not given
